note.text: Infrastructure bets in AI rarely wait for proof of demand; they create the conditions demand later grows into. Building the capacity first, before the use case is obvious, looks reckless until the market catches up and the bet looks inevitable in hindsight. Most organizations wait for certainty that never arrives, then pay retail prices for capacity the early movers locked in cheap. The real risk isn't overbuilding too early, it's arriving on time to a market that already closed.
